headline: 🔥 THE FIRST-EVER SHOWING ON THE 1.15-MILLION-DOLLAR LISTING IS IN THE HOUSE RIGHT NOW, 12:30 TO 1:15 — the feedback call this afternoon is the only read this listing will ever get from it, and the 11:00 appraisal on the 899,000-dollar file came and went with no signal, which is normal.

hotSignals.signal: 🔥 HAPPENING NOW, 12:30-1:15 PM. The most expensive listing on the board is taking its first real appointment ever, with Mason P. (Stratford Real Estate). The notice printed it without ambiguity: 'Showings by this Agent: 1 / Total # of Showings: 1' - $1,150,000 | ACTIVE | ID# 21459396. Five days live at 807 Zillow views and 27 saves produced zero tours until this one; the only prior booking was confirmed Fri 7/24 2:27 PM and cancelled 73 minutes later. The milestone engine fired ACTIVE -> SHOWING_ACTIVITY at 8:05 this morning and Gene sent the sellers his own written follow-up at 8:24.
hotSignals.action: ⭐ THE FEEDBACK CALL IS THIS AFTERNOON AND IT IS THE WHOLE GAME - this is the only read this listing will get from the only tour it has ever had. Ask what the buyer has already seen in Helena and what 12:30 was competing against, then call the sellers back the same day. His direct line is a Michigan area code, so establish whether this is a relocation. 🔴 ONE AWKWARD THING TO GET AHEAD OF: the seller received the 1,900-address marketing email about his own house while the showing was running, and the body asks the reader to forward it along. Thirty seconds on the phone beats him building his own theory - and it folds into the feedback call already owed. ⚠️ The landing page still sells this house as Coming Soon while the MLS reads ACTIVE; that contradiction has been open since Monday and is now the page a very large audience can land on. ⭐ Open house Sunday 1-3.

hotSignals.signal: ⭐ THE MOST USEFUL READ THIS HOUSE HAS PRODUCED. Susan B. (Entera Realty) answered: interested — No; priced right — JUST RIGHT; staging — 4 of 5. And in the box asking for a price-change recommendation she typed, verbatim: "House seemed dirty and the electrical seemed to be glitching." She put a CONDITION objection where a number belongs, and separately validated the number. That is the second independent agent in a week to call this price just right.
hotSignals.action: 🔴 THE ELECTRICAL IS THE ITEM. "Glitching" on a $559,000 house that just fell out of contract for a reason nobody has ever established is worth an electrician before the next tour rather than after — it may be the answer to what killed the contract. And a cleaner is the cheapest fix on this entire board: the house reads dirty to buyers at 38 lifetime showings. ⛔ DO NOT take a price conversation to this seller off this read — the feedback explicitly does not support one, and the last three reads have blamed schools, EIFS and now condition. Nobody has said the number.

hotSignals.action: ⚠️ THE OVERDUE ITEM IS NOT THE APPRAISAL, IT IS THE DECISION. The $18,750 repair ask is still unruled and the seller has been silent since 2:14 PM Tuesday.
